Resolves #4386

The Phone field accepts international formats such as `+49 (151) 1234 567` and `+49(151)1234567`. Parenthesized groups must contain digits and close correctly; existing slash, dot, hyphen and space forms remain supported. Validation still uses `Text.validate()`, including blank/required handling, caller overrides and clearing errors after an edit.

Evidence: L1 field-validation and regex behavior. No browser or worker-transport change is claimed.

## AC Evidence

No structured ACs on #4386. The original reported format, malformed-group controls and inherited validation behavior are CI-covered by `PhoneValidate.spec.mjs`; the existing long-input guard remains in `PhoneInputPatternReDoS.spec.mjs`. [Current-intent intake and contract](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/4386#issuecomment-6655591552).

## Deltas from ticket

The same syntax repair rejects unmatched `(123` and `123)`, which previously passed. The security spec's old rejection of `+1 (123) 456-789` is updated to reflect the intended international format; its 50,000-digit failing-input performance guard and slash-inside-parentheses refusals remain intact.

## Test Evidence

Outside-CI red-first check: before the fix, the new field spec failed the reported format, unmatched-parenthesis and error-clearing cases (3 failed, 2 passed). Routine regression coverage runs in CI.

A bounded comparison against `6ddbed1bd5e67822510c8ab3ece3340f58994313` enumerated 597,871 strings of length 0–6 over `01()+/ -.`: all 6,330 balanced inputs accepted by the old pattern remain accepted. Three 100,000-digit invalid suffix/unclosed-group controls rejected; the existing CI performance guard remains the executable timing check. The alternatives have disjoint first characters, and the digit run inside a group ends at a literal `)`.

An extra standalone `TextReset.spec.mjs` run failed its three cases at `Neo.vdom.Helper.create` before assertions; the same failure reproduces without this Phone spec. No Text/reset implementation changed. This is outside the focused green slice.

`agent-preflight` is not hosted in Engine; the shared baseline and unit jobs provide its applicable checks.
